name: cbp-workflows
description: The hub's quality trio of orchestrated workflows — code-review, documentation, and skill-authoring — installed as one plugin instead of copied into each repo (#187 distribution pilot). Ships each workflow's level-1 dispatch closure (13 sub-skills + 4 worker agents) so a downstream project gets working /code-review-workflow, /documentation-workflow, and /skill-authoring-workflow from one /plugin install, centrally versioned and upgradable.
